goal: Return the business-day count between two ISO dates (YYYY-MM-DD), excluding weekends
assumptions: Input dates are strings in ISO format YYYY-MM-DD.
The count includes both the start and end dates if they are business days.
Weekends are defined as Saturday and Sunday.
If start date is after end date, the function returns 0 (or a negative count is not specified; we assume 0).
The function returns an integer count of business days.
No timezone or locale considerations; dates are treated as calendar dates.
Invalid date strings are not specified, so no validation is required beyond normal Python date parsing behavior.
